1934, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 175 Cont.
Feb. 14 Mrs. M. Wysocki - 31 - operation proposed and arranged for to-mor- row - cancer of intestines.
Mrs. Elen Ferry - 76 - nervous heart - sometimes like dead .. ...
Ben LaBrett - Jew, doctoring has been doctoring for yrs. every- where with very little results. Cath. neighbor was asked to en- roll him To-day - 50¢ 2:45 P.M.
Feb. 16 Wm Muzheck - 30 - divorcing wife and baby living with mother of 40 .....
.. . . of Miami Fl. - 37 - mind of 12 yr. child.
Mrs. Mrs. Jen. Sullivan - 78 - very sick and sadest - not in Church ... many years.
Chester Kozelsky - 21 - in Receiving Hosp. unconscious - badly frac- tured skull - Mother here from Penn'a ....
Mr. Kelly - 40 - wayward, ungrateful to benefactors . . ..
Virginia DeFanjo - 3 - new sickness, had 107 fever ... . not out of danger.
Page 176 Feb. 21 Baby Francis Allen - 8 mo. - head aches & bowel
Mrs. Sarah McEntee - 49 - lung trouble
Margaret Kaminski - 15 - appendicitis - to be operated Wed. 21st - To-day.
Mrs. M. Derry - about 40 - married out of Church about 20 yrs. Edna Gabrish - 34 - paraplsed at birth of last baby (7) and speech- less. Prayed for two weeks ago - now able to talk and pray.
Mrs. DeHaney - 43 - pneumonia - very ... Mrs. Julia Lyons - 54 - fears loss of eyes. Mr. Prudom - 40 - 4 yrs. out of work. R. Bertheume - 32 - sleeping sick. 10 yrs.
